collection.title: Porsche Macan 2024 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Porsche Macan 2026 Onwards (Electric) requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
